name: drip-type
description: Private, configurable typing for macOS and Windows — Drip Type by Zap.
author: VegaNext LLC

scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/index.js && node --check src/quick.js && node --check src/shortcut-utils.js && node --check src/typing-engine.js && node --check src/text-tools.js && node --check src/pro-tools.js && node --check src/subscription.js && node --check src/onboarding.js && node --check website/account.js && node --check website/home-demo.js && node --check website/navigation.js && node --check website/checkout.js && node --check website/support.js && node --check website/api/_auth.js && node --check website/api/_billing.js && node --check website/api/account-config.js && node --check website/api/account-status.js && node --check website/api/claim-account-entitlement.js && node --check website/api/create-account-portal.js && node --check website/api/create-app-activation.js && node --check website/api/create-checkout.js && node --check website/api/stripe-webhook.js && node --check website/api/support-ticket.js && node --check scripts/build-app.js && node --check scripts/after-pack.js && node --check scripts/publish-update-blobs.js && node --check scripts/test-shortcuts.js && node --check scripts/test-typing-engine.js && node --check scripts/verify-api.js && node --check scripts/verify-source.js && node --check scripts/verify-package.js
scripts.test:source: node scripts/test-shortcuts.js && node scripts/test-typing-engine.js && node scripts/verify-source.js && node scripts/verify-api.js
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:source && npm run build:app
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:app && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:app && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never

releaseInfo.releaseNotes: Drip Type now runs on Windows with native system-wide Unicode typing, Alt+5 global Composer access, secure Windows entitlement storage, Windows installers, and automatic updates. macOS behavior remains unchanged.

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Drip Type uses macOS System Events to type text into the application you choose.
extendInfo.NSAccessibilityUsageDescription: Drip Type needs Accessibility access to type text into other applications.
